text: Regulating blockchain through the non anonymous application of the technology creates large inefficiencies that will be bypassed by the more efficient anonymous applications, and it is for those more advanced applications that a system of distributed jurisdiction will be needed.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
abstract: However, that application of the technology creates large inefficiencies that will be bypassed by the more efficient applications of the technology in an anonymous setting. It is for this more advanced application of blockchain technology that a system of distributed jurisdiction will be needed.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: uniform application of Bank Secrecy Act and anti money laundering compliance to virtual currency businesses
